_doc: Station-calibrated official-forecast sources. ENABLED sources are ingested live by the forecast availability lane (replacement_forecast_production._ingest_station_forecasts_live -> station_forecast_adapter.ingest_enabled_station_sources_live), routed by adapter_kind on each source's own poll_interval_seconds. Each source reaches its city's served center ONLY via the per-city source-clock scheme weight (DATA PRECISION, never a de-bias). Set enabled=false to drop a source from live ingest.

cwa_township.auth: env CWA_API_KEY (forecast-live plist) or gitignored config/cwa_secret.json — NEVER committed
cwa_township.notes: Retained only to interpret already-persisted F-D0047-063 raw evidence. Its Songshan township representative point (25.051608, 121.568983) differs from the RCSS settlement sensor (25.067244, 121.552822), and its 06:00-18:00 MaxT is not a full Asia/Taipei calendar-day maximum. It is never an entry source; F-D0047-061 complete hourly Temperature is the live replacement.

cwa_township_hourly_high.auth: env CWA_API_KEY (forecast-live plist) or gitignored config/cwa_secret.json — NEVER committed
cwa_township_hourly_high.notes: CWA F-D0047-061 complete official XML. Shared with the LOW sibling in one fetch; only D+1 Asia/Taipei 00:00..23:00 with 24 unique finite whole-hour samples is persisted as HIGH=max. DatasetInfo.Update is its publisher revision clock and local capture is the availability proof.

cwa_township_hourly_low.auth: env CWA_API_KEY (forecast-live plist) or gitignored config/cwa_secret.json — NEVER committed
cwa_township_hourly_low.notes: CWA F-D0047-061 complete official XML. Shared with the HIGH sibling in one fetch; only D+1 Asia/Taipei 00:00..23:00 with 24 unique finite whole-hour samples is persisted as LOW=min. DatasetInfo.Update is its publisher revision clock and local capture is the availability proof.

hko_fnd.notes: HKO Nine-Day Forecast (fnd). weatherForecast[].forecastMaxtemp.value and forecastMintemp.value degC, forecastDate YYYYMMDD. One issue is fetched once and persisted as distinct HIGH/LOW rows. updateTime is the issue/cycle clock.
